asset.sourceFrameLimits: The exact NPS-delivered 460×460 image is already cropped; its source impression’s missing margins and scan original remain unidentified. A different complete UNT print was privately compared for design/title/imprint; that comparison copy is not reproduced.
asset.scope: NPS explicitly identifies this as a drawing of a Lipan man on horseback and credits NPS. The design was compared with the complete primary museum/UNT image of the print catalogued as published in 1857; the title and Schott / Sarony, Major & Knapp imprint were visible in that comparison. Reuse of the old design is based on its documented nineteenth-century publication, not on an inference that Schott was an NPS employee or that NPS owns every hosted image. National Library of Medicine historical-copyright guidance was inspected for the pre-1923 public-domain rule. Exact NPS source impression, scan lineage and digital preparer remain unidentified, and no individual permission grant, CC0 or Creative Commons license is claimed. This is an outside historical illustration, not a photograph, a named current community member, Lipan-made artwork, a universal depiction of clothing or a surveyed territorial boundary. The exact downloaded 460×460 agency detail was visually inspected and copied byte-for-byte with no resizing, retouching, generation or additional pixel crop. It is already cropped and low resolution; the NPS source impression’s missing margins and scanner original were not inspected. CSS crops/overlays apply to the directory card and backdrop; the opened-page image retains the complete delivered square detail. The UNT comparison was private identification research only and is not reproduced; its undetermined digital-object rights and NMAH/NMAI restrictions are not treated as permissions. Existing NMAI saddlebag rights deferral remains unchanged.
